entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I know we already saw one o' these[n]earlier in the Palace, but man, is it ugly.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I mean, it's a golden piggy bank.[n]Pretty obvious that money's the[n]only thing on his mind.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Hmm, it doesn't seem like it wants[n]to open.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: We should be able to find the controls[n]for this if we look around well enough.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: We may have found the controls we've[n]been looking for. Anything we can do[n]here?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Oh, look! The shutter's gone![n]We can keep going now!

entries.speaker: PA System
entries.en: Attention all guards! Attention all guards!

entries.speaker: PA System
entries.en: The rats have made their way to every[n]floor! Tighten security at all levels!

entries.speaker: PA System
entries.en: They must not proceed any further![n]Protect the golden pig at all costs!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Man, he seems really worked up...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: He must truly not want us gaining[n]access to this "golden pig."

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Well, pretty sure that one there's[n]the one he mentioned. Pretty[n]suspicious, if you ask me...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Hm? There's a note here... It says "[clr 2]P=I[clr 27]."

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...The hell's that supposed to mean?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Wait, the edge of it is torn. Maybe it[n]came from Kaneshiro's journal?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Oh, so it's the continuation of the code[n]we found in there! This should be useful!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Hm? There's a note here... I wonder if this[n]is a hint for solving the PIN input code.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: But, uh... I'm pretty sure we already[n]figured this one out.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: So we solved it even without all[n]the hints. We're so smart!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Hm? There's a note here...[n]It says "[clr 2]E=9 A=3[clr 27]."

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It seems to be the same as the one[n]we found earlier. The edge here is[n]frayed as well.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Perfect! The more hints we find, the[n]closer we get to solving the code.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Come on, let's hurry over[n]to the input machine!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: This is some kind of note, right?[n]Do you think it's a hint?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: We have already solved the PIN[n]associated with it though. We were[n]a bit late in obtaining this.
